input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 is structurally sound: the cap is expressly mutual, § 21.2 excludes indirect and consequential damages for "neither Party", and § 21.3 already places confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP outside the cap. The cap basis fails on a material term: "Fees" is defined at §§ 1.5-1.6 as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, and § 21.1 further confines the measure to the first Order Form, so the twelve-month formula is illusory and sits below the walk-away line. The § 21.3 payment carve-out is tied to the same narrow defined term, so Customer's payment obligations as a whole are not excluded from capped damages. We therefore target the preferred position with two surgical edits: § 21.1 becomes the greater of fees paid or payable under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, and the § 21.3 payment sentence changes only its basis to amounts due, retaining the Customer-favourable "undisputed" and "for conforming Services" limiters. The mutuality sentence, § 21.2 and the full Excluded Claims list are retained verbatim.

proposal.summary: Cap set at greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000; payment carve-out basis widened to amounts due, keeping the undisputed/conforming limiters.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000; as drafted the basis is illusory because "Fees" is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form. We have reset the cap basis in § 21.1 and changed only the "Fees" basis in the § 21.3 payment carve-out to amounts due, keeping the "undisputed" and "for conforming Services" limiters and leaving the mutual cap, the mutual exclusion of indirect damages and the Excluded Claims carve-outs untouched.
